Subject: Discovery recap + proposal: rotational rendezvous for multi‑TZ demo

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed next step to lock down the technical deep dive: 

Key highlights from our call:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low‑latency, cost‑predictable inference for your triage/clinical summarization pipelines.
- Constraints: PHI-sensitive data in scope (on‑prem option preferred); target 99th pct latency < 150ms for 512‑token responses; pilot team = 5 engineers + 1 security lead.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff target = mid‑Nov; procurement will be involved for contract & legal.

To make scheduling straightforward across your US/EU/APAC contributors, I sketched a rotating meeting cadence that keeps calendars fair and ensures coverage for live demos and SE Q&A. Proposed "Rotational Rendezvous" (three‑week rotation):

Option A — Week 1: US‑friendly mornings / Week 2: EU afternoons / Week 3: APAC evenings
Option B — Week 1: EU afternoons / Week 2: APAC evenings / Week 3: US mornings
Option C — Fixed monthly deep dive + weekly short office hours rotated by region

Concrete slot suggestions (all 30m deep‑dive + 15m prep buffer):
- US window: 08:30–10:00 PT / 11:30–13:00 ET
- EU window: 14:00–16:00 CET
- APAC window: 18:00–20:00 IST / 22:00–00:00 JST (we keep APAC earlier/later depending on team preference)

Ask: please pick the preferred rotation order (A/B/C) and which of the concrete time bands you prefer for the first demo. I can lock a recurring 3‑week series and include our SE (Ben) + a short mutual action plan.

I attached a 1‑page proposal and a starter mutual action plan (editable). Also sharing a one‑click scheduling link if you prefer to pick a time directly: https://cal.com/monica-demo/30min

Next steps I propose once you pick a slot:
- I’ll create the recurring invite and include Ben (SE) + Marissa (sales lead) for the first two sessions.
- Ben will prepare a short environment questionnaire (pre‑demo checklist) to help us tailor the demo to your data shapes.
- I’ll loop in procurement and security with a starter SOC2 evidence packet we can share.

Thanks — looking forward to getting a slot on the calendar.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
